routing_description: Temperature warnings, rising coolant readings and changes in cooling behavior.
planner_instructions: Coolant history provides individual chronological readings; the summary provides endpoints, extrema and arithmetic change with supporting IDs. Neither supplies thresholds or diagnostic interpretation. Preserve units and timestamps and cite supporting observations. Separate a sustained change from a single reading using the available history. If temperature observations are missing, identify that gap and use the owner message as a report rather than inventing measurements. No manufacturer limits are supplied by this pack.
